summary: Comprehensive E2E testing of FLOWX (React + FastAPI + MongoDB). Backend: 20/20 pytest cases passed covering auth (register/login/me/refresh/logout, cookies+bearer, duplicate 409, short password 400, wrong password 401), user CRUD (settings/profile/favorites/alerts with free-plan 402 limit at 5/journal with PnL math/layouts/signals dedupe/usage/heartbeat), public (plans/health/contact), admin (overview/users/patch plan/settings) with trader 403 forbidden. Frontend: Landing hero + 10 features + 3 pricing plans + terminal-preview visible; Auth: demo-trader-button -> /dashboard, demo-admin-button -> /admin, wrong password shows auth-error 'Invalid email or password'; Dashboard: all 5 cards present, fav-toggle + save-layout work; Terminal (public): became LIVE on BINANCE within ~1s with real price 85,146.2, DOM panel + 11 tape rows + footprint canvas (1546x768) rendering, all 8 bottom tabs present, signal-bias LONG BIAS visible, Bybit switch shows SIM; Admin: all 3 feeds show CONNECTED (BINANCE/BYBIT/GATE.IO) with msgs/sec, user-management with plan select + system-settings save (alertCooldownSec 90 persisted); Mobile 390x844: mobile-terminal renders LIVE with 6 mobile-nav buttons.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 741 lines; consider splitting into modules (auth, users, admin, feeds) for maintainability but acceptable for MVP
login_attempts lockout keyed by client.host+email — behind a proxy all users share one IP; consider using X-Forwarded-For (minor security hardening)
set_auth_cookies uses samesite='none' + secure=True — correct for cross-site cookies; works because the preview is HTTPS
SignalLog dedupe compares created_at as ISO string — works since ISO is lexicographically sortable, acceptable
seed_data_creation: Tests create ephemeral TEST_* users and alerts/journal/layouts/signals rows for the trader. No cleanup is implemented but items are small volume. Admin PATCH keeps trader on 'pro' plan (idempotent).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All APIs green and all key UI flows pass. Backend/frontend are feature-complete per spec. If re-testing, note Binance feed is live (not geo-blocked for spot WS) and real market data appears instantly. Bybit/Gate.io are also connected on backend (uses WSS endpoints) and both SIM in frontend terminal by design.
